title: Adecto, Aviceda shut down
snippet: Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.

title: Shionogi makes $2B rare disease play with IntraBio buy
snippet: With its acquisition of IntraBio, Shionogi will gain ownership over Aqneursa, which could hit peak global sales of $1 billion across its two indications in Niemann-Pick disease type C and ataxia-telangiectasia, according to Jefferies.

title: FDA extends review of Novo’s hemophilia A drug, citing manufacturing issues
snippet: Despite the regulatory delay, Novo is still expecting a 2027 launch for its hemophilia A drug denecimig.

title: AbbVie, Genmab's Epkinly sets ‘new standard of care’ in first-line lymphoma in Phase 3
snippet: AbbVie and Genmab’s bispecific antibody blew analyst expectations out of the water with a 51% improvement in progression-free survival when used alongside a standard frontline regimen in diffuse large B cell lymphoma—potentially setting up a battle with Roche's Polivy.

title: Compliance concerns hinder rollout of AI in drug manufacturing: Survey
snippet: While AI is taking off in biopharma for administrative tasks and drug discovery efforts, more than 90% of drugmakers have yet to commit to scaling AI use in regulated biopharma manufacturing, according to CRB’s new Horizons: Life Sciences report.

title: BioSpace 40 Under 40 winners make their mark on biopharma
snippet: 40 Under 40 honorees’ accomplishments include co-developing the world’s first synthetic biology programming language for mRNA and co-founding and leading a company acquired for $700 million up-front and up to $1.225 billion in total consideration.
